usage: Personal avatar life stickers. Original portraits are unchanged; shared lower-body sprites and liquid are separate runtime layers. Magenta backgrounds use UI/GovnoStickerCutout at render time; original generated pixels are preserved.

assets.name: lower-suit
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE modular lower-body raster sprite for a small 2D cartoon game character.
Input portrait is a COSTUME and illustration-style reference only. Draw ONLY the missing lower half of its clothing: jacket/garment bottom below the chest, short legs, and shoes. NO head, neck, shoulders, upper chest, arms, hands, props, or extra objects. This broad flat-topped fragment attaches beneath the exact existing portrait, so it should be WIDE AT THE TOP (matching width of shoulders), then taper towards feet. Front view, level feet, compact adult cartoon proportions. Clean black outline, soft cel shading, consistent with reference.
ONE shape on square canvas, nearly fills canvas (3 percent clear margins), total silhouette about as wide as tall. Upper garment tails 35 percent height, legs and shoes65 percent. Both shoes visible. No cast shadow or floor or captions.
BACKGROUND IS SOLID PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF, completely uniform including gap between legs. No checkerboard, no transparency simulation, no gradients/shadows on background. This pink is an intentional chroma-key background for the game renderer. No pink pixels in clothing.
Costume: black charcoal suit jacket tails, matching black trousers and polished black leather shoes. Subtle gray highlights, elegant simple formalwear.

assets.name: mud-pool
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE reusable cartoon brown sludge puddle for a 2D game life-sticker.
Draw a low flat wide oval pool of warm medium brown liquid, strong dark brown outline and a few cream caramel shiny ripples. View slightly from above so an oval surface is visible. The front edge is softly scalloped. A smooth continuous FULL pool, no hole in the center, no characters or clothes, no hands, no splashes above the pool, no text.
Polished outlined cel-shaded cartoon style matching an illustrated casual card game. NOT realistic dirt/feces.
Wide landscape canvas aspect 3:1. Pool fills 94 percent WIDTH and about75 percent HEIGHT, centered. Outside the pool SOLID PURE MAGENTA #FF00FF uniform flat backdrop, no gradient, no shadow, no checkerboard. The game renderer removes the magenta.
A single flat sprite with clearly defined edges, low ellipse suitable for layering in front of a character. No other objects.
